per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall respond to user interactions within five seconds for general UI navigation, search results, and simple forms.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall complete payment processing within fifteen seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that initial streaming buffering does not exceed ten seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement adaptive bitrate streaming to adjust the video quality based on the user's network connection.
The system shall achieve and maintain an uptime of 99.5%.
The system shall allow users to create an account within four pages from the landing page.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should only have to navigate through a maximum of 4 pages to create an account with the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be usable by 90% of users who can browse social media but aren't tech-savvy.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall encrypt credit card details and restrict access to authorized personnel only.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement role-based access control to separate duties between program admins and support staff.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All customer information will be stored on a secure database accessible only to authorized personnel.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall detect and respond to suspicious activities such as repeated failed logins, credential stuffing patterns, and suspicious card activity.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall notify admins of security events via email for alerts and SMS/push for severe issues.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall comply with W3C standards for accessibility, including semantic HTML and ARIA support.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website will comply with W3C standards.'

The system shall provide actionable dashboards for business decisions, including revenue over time, top titles, and redemption rates for pre-paids.
